nyalkan.options.advCulling.tooltip: Use a culling algorithm that might improve performance by reducing the number of non visible chunk sections rendered.
nyalkan.options.ao.subBlock.tooltip: ON (Sub-block): Enables smooth lighting for non full block (experimental).
nyalkan.options.entityCulling.tooltip: Enables culling for entities on not visible sections.
nyalkan.options.hudBatching.tooltip: Draws each HUD layer's elements grouped by texture instead of one at a time.
nyalkan.options.fpsOverlay.tooltip: Shows FPS, min, max, 1% low and frame time in the top left corner, over the last 10 seconds. Updates twice a second. Hidden while F3 or the profiler is open.
nyalkan.options.hudCaching.tooltip: Redraws the HUD only as often as your monitor refreshes and reuses the last image in between. The vignette and crosshair stay live. When your FPS is below the refresh rate it switches to HUD Rate Below Refresh.
nyalkan.options.smoothHudUpdates.tooltip: Spreads each cached HUD update over several frames for steadier frame times. Slightly lower average FPS. Needs HUD Caching.
nyalkan.options.entityBackfaceCulling.to: Skips building mob and block entity model faces that point away from the camera, which the GPU would throw away anyway. Only for models that are drawn with culling, never in menus or previews.
nyalkan.options.hudLowFpsRate.tooltip: When your FPS is below the refresh rate, the cached HUD redraws this many times per second instead of turning off. Higher looks smoother, lower is faster. Off draws the HUD every frame there. Needs HUD Caching.
nyalkan.options.gpuParticles.tooltip: Builds plain particles on the GPU from one snapshot per tick instead of on the CPU every frame.
nyalkan.options.mipmapSpriteFix.tooltip: One texture with an odd size (like 1x1 or 18x18) normally turns off mipmaps for every block, making distant terrain shimmer. This scales such textures up without changing how they look so mipmaps stay on. Applies after a resource reload (F3+T) or restart.
nyalkan.options.bakedBlockEntities.toolt: Draws closed vanilla chests and beds as part of the chunk mesh instead of rendering them every frame. Chests switch back while their lid moves.
nyalkan.options.blockEntityReplay.toolti: Runs block entity renderers at 60/30/15 Hz by distance and reuses their output in between.
nyalkan.options.entityReplay.tooltip: Mobs further than 24 blocks are redrawn at 30 Hz (15 Hz past 48 blocks) and moved smoothly in between.
nyalkan.options.occlusionCulling.tooltip: Skips block entities, mobs and effect particles hidden behind terrain, using a small depth map from two frames ago.
nyalkan.options.tickSpreading.tooltip: Mobs further than 32 blocks tick on the frames between game ticks instead of all at once, which smooths out the regular frame time spikes. Each mob still ticks once per game tick.
nyalkan.options.modelReplay.tooltip: When a model is drawn again in the same frame with the same pose (like villager clothing layers), copies the first result instead of rebuilding it.
nyalkan.options.animationLod.tooltip: Recomputes animations of supported mob models less often when they are far away and reuses the last pose in between. Mobs within 16 blocks animate every frame.
nyalkan.options.poseReuse.tooltip: Reuses matrix objects when models are drawn instead of allocating new ones.
nyalkan.options.animateOnlyVisible.toolt: Only animated textures that are on screen are updated.
nyalkan.options.frameQueue.tooltip: Higher values might help stabilize frametime but will increase input lag.
nyalkan.options.indirectDraw.tooltip: Reduces CPU overhead but increases GPU overhead. Enabling it might help in CPU limited systems.
nyalkan.options.uniqueOpaqueLayer.toolti: Use a unique render layer for opaque terrain to improve performance.
nyalkan.options.title: Nyalkan Settings
nyalkan.options.settingsStyle.tooltip: Modern replaces Video Settings with this screen. Classic keeps the vanilla Video Settings screen with a Nyalkan button. Applies the next time you open Video Settings.
nyalkan.options.settingsStyle.later: You can switch any time under Settings Style
nyalkan.options.settingsStyle.modern.des: One tidy screen with pages and search for every video and Nyalkan setting.
nyalkan.options.settingsStyle.classic.de: The vanilla Video Settings screen, with Nyalkan's options one click away.
